task.question: Where was the closing ceremony of the 2026 Winter Olympics held?
task.evidence: The closing ceremony was held in Verona Arena.
task.page: Chronological summary of the 2026 Winter Olympics

answer:
The 2026 Winter Olympics (Milano Cortina 2026) closing ceremony was held at the Mediolanum Forum in Assago (Milan), Italy.

FINAL: Mediolanum Forum, Milan (Assago), Italy
